verdict.rationale: The IRS does document its own machine-to-machine channels: Modernized e-File is an XML system-to-system transmission rail, and IRIS has an Application-to-Application intake. Both can run headless, but only behind credentialed enrollment: Authorized e-file Provider approval takes up to 45 days and may require fingerprinting, and IRIS A2A needs a Transmitter Control Code. Taxpayer-facing services (EIN assistant, Online Account, signed forms) sit behind a time-windowed, session-limited UI and an ID.me biometric liveness wall, and probes found no public API and a 403 for keyless agents. Missing for 10: a public self-serve API or CLI, headless access to Online Account, EIN, or signed-form flows, published API specs or OpenAPI, and any documented CI/automation guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
